scope: Actual GLB triangles; 0.20m free-space grid; 2.10m capsule + .05m margin, radius .40m+.05m; point-to-triangle/segment-to-triangle clearance and supported transitions. Static offline test, not engine physics.
limitations: Mesh surfaces are tested statically; no game engine or animated door/controller/camera executed.
Uniform grid is sampled, not exhaustive continuous configuration-space proof.
Gentle-slope grounding lifts the capsule by radius*(sec(slope)-1) on actual supporting triangle planes up to35degrees.
Triangles entirely below .205m above local foot are allowed as a step-over envelope; engine stepping remains untested.

Only actual upward-facing support triangles establish ground; a metadata height hint cannot substitute a closed terrain underside. Overlapping multilevel floor layers are not modeled by this heightfield-style support search.
Room functional topology, single-leaf identity, slope comfort and fixture usability require separate semantic/visual review.
